name: Web Server Management (Python/Node.js)
description: Start, test, and manage web servers (Flask, FastAPI, Express, etc.) in background mode.
instructions: When starting a web server, always use `execute_command` with `background: true` so it does not block. Use `check_port` to find a free port if the default is occupied. After starting, test the server with `curl` or a simple HTTP request. If the server fails, inspect logs or stderr. Prefer using `PORT` environment variable to make the app configurable.
examples: Start a Flask app: check_port 5000, then execute_command 'python app.py' with background: true, then curl http://localhost:5000 to verify.
constraints: Never start a server without verifying the port is free.
Always confirm the server is responding before reporting success.
